title: Bass players of the Nola band and Ulyss John
summary: Russ recalls bassist R.T. and identifies the trumpeter Ulyss John from Boundtown.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: But who was the bass player with the Nola band?
Uh, I'm trying to call this—we had a boy by the name of R.T. That's a— R.T. That's all right. R.T., yeah.
That's a—I was fine. I was fine.

And, uh, they used to call him R.T. And, uh, another guy used to play with the Nola band. Was playing with the Nola band when I went to Nola band after Eddie Jassie. I can't think of that boy named, uh, to save my life. He was a pretty good—he was Gene Bush bass player, too. I'm trying to call this man. I can't call it. Well, don't worry about it. We'll think of it. It'll come, then. Yeah, can I? Maybe. Yeah. I'll think about it.
Did you know a trumpet player named John—uh, Ulyss John?

Ulyss John. Yeah. That's the boy I'm trying to call his name. That's the one you were thinking about a while ago? That's the one I'm trying to call his name. From Boundtown. Oh, I see. That's the one. Ulyss John is his name. That's the boy. Yeah. I knew his name was Ulyss, but I didn't know his—I forgot his last name. Yeah. And, uh, going back to the Nola band, huh?
Yeah, yeah. I just wanted to check back.
And I—yeah, that's the boy I'm in. Ulyss John.
